caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object with a design that mimics the appearance of a cast iron panel or architectural plaque. The main object is bordered on the left and right by vertical, cylindrical columns. The central portion features an ornate motif in relief: at the top, a symmetrical, stylized acanthus leaf extends upward. Below the leaf, scrolling decorative elements curve outward from the center. In the middle, there is an oval medallion with a rope-like border, containing a smaller, textured design. Below the medallion, additional scrolling elements extend downward, terminating in a cluster of three rounded forms at the bottom. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting an iron or bronze material, with darker and lighter areas indicating highlights and shadows to give a three-dimensional effect. The background is a neutral off-white, and no other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Pa. German Stove and Plate
